labels.as_is: As found: vendor default rules, no behavioural rules or re-screening, manual review first in first out, alerts polled hourly
labels.kit: The pilot kit: rules compiled from discovery and tuned on shared history, behavioural rules, re-screening, governed AI triage, priority queue, webhooks
labels.untuned: Rules compiled from discovery, not tuned
labels.no_rescreen: No re-screening when a counterparty is attributed later
labels.no_triage: Tuned rules, manual review without evidence packs or drafts
labels.ungoverned_triage: AI triage closes low scores on its own, no hard rules, no sampling
labels.fifo_queue: First in, first out instead of priority

discovery.name: Seeblick Privatbank (fictional)
discovery.kind: private bank with a crypto custody and trading desk

rules.fires: any transfer with sanctions, ransomware, darknet_market, mixer
funds from sanctions, ransomware, darknet_market, mixer within 3 hops
any transfer with scam, stolen_funds, no_kyc_exchange
rules.threshold: retail >= EUR 0, hnw >= EUR 0, business >= EUR 0

rules.fires: funds from scam, stolen_funds, no_kyc_exchange within 2 hops
a past counterparty is attributed later
rules.severity: as the rule it would have fired

rules.fires: sent to gambling in 24 h
unhosted withdrawals at 60-100% of EUR 1,000 in 7 days
rising payments to one counterparty the customer had not paid in the 30 days before
deposit with high-risk or prohibited exposure forwarded within 24 h
